changelog: Fix: 0005's data work already succeeded on live (trade 80 at 06:08:19, fee 3.8669, SUM(fees) exactly 138.1159), but the file's pre-flight guard blocked its own result on retry -- it asserted trade 80 was still at its pre-fix timestamp (06:08:00), which the successful run had already corrected. Narrowed the guard to an identity check (trade 80 is still BNBUSDT/Long under challenge 6), dropping the timestamp condition -- the fix statement itself has no time_in condition and is already safe to re-run either way

Process: this is the fourth guard in this release chain to encode 'hasn't been fixed yet' instead of 'is in a state safe to proceed from,' and the fourth time it blocked a legitimate retry. Documented as a general rule in CLAUDE.md: a pre-flight guard in a retryable migration must accept every state the file can legitimately leave things in, not just the pre-fix state

Fix: SUM(net_pnl) is -258.1909, not the -258.1959 the post-flight guard asserted. Real precision, not an error -- trade 80's pnl is stored at 4-decimal precision (-98.6850, from TradeController's round($pnl,4) on manual entry), not the 2-decimal -98.68 the fees CSV displays, so net_pnl = pnl - 3.8669 correctly evaluates to -102.5519. Same class of gap as the -120.07/-120.08 difference in v3.13.2, resolved the same way: trust the stored column, correct the guard. Derived balance is now 9735.1722 (0.0050 off Bitfunded's reported 9735.1772, a smaller residual than v3.13.2's estimate) -- documented, not forced to match

No other changes -- 0004 and 0006 untouched. 0006's own guard (checking for orphaned trades.challenge_id) was already a proper precondition check, not a 'hasn't run yet' check, and needed no fix -- it was only ever blocked by 0005 sorting first in filename order
